description: Test / QA only — do not use for customer orders. Returns the Cardano preprod payment session of an order placed by a GYOTAK test customer (status, amount, deadline, TX hash if paid). For any other order_id it returns PromptPay guidance and nothing about the order. Customers pay via the PromptPay QR attached to the order confirmation email and receive an email once the payment is confirmed.
name: check_payment_status
